---
title: "Historical results"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
sources <- lb_table("historical_sources")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (is.null(sources) || !nrow(sources)) {
  cat("_No historical results were imported into this report._ Use ",
      "`lidarbench report --historical SOURCE` with a directory of legacy per-run CSVs or ",
      "a `lidarbench.legacy-r-campaign/1` export.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("::: {.callout-important}\nHistorical R results are imported read-only and are ",
      "**descriptive only**. Their task IDs are kept verbatim and are **not** mapped onto ",
      "lidarbench workload contracts; legacy per-run CSVs have no campaign identity and no ",
      "validation. They never enter comparisons, speedups or the campaign tables. ",
      "The published historical site is not modified.\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("## Sources\n\n")
  lb_kable(sources)
  cat("## Summary\n\nOne row per source, host, task, run, tool and tool version ",
      "(versions and machines are never pooled).\n\n", sep = "")
  lb_kable(lb_table("historical_summary"),
           c("source_kind", "legacy_campaign_id", "host", "legacy_task_id", "run_id", "tool",
             "tool_version", "cores", "n_records", "n_included", "n_failed", "median_seconds",
             "sd_seconds", "min_seconds", "max_seconds", "validation_statuses",
             "timing_precision"))
  lb_download("historical_summary")
  lb_download("historical_attempts", "Download every historical record (historical_attempts.csv)")
}
```
